title: Jira Service Management
description: Read selected Jira Service Management Cloud customer request metadata.

jira_service_management.authMode.title: Authentication
jira_service_management.authMode.description: Choose a classic or scoped API token for a personal script, or an externally managed OAuth 2.0 access token.

jira_service_management.domain.title: Cloud domain
jira_service_management.domain.description: Required for classic API-token and OAuth modes: Atlassian Cloud hostname such as example.atlassian.net.

jira_service_management.apiToken.title: API token
jira_service_management.apiToken.description: For either API-token mode: use a RocketRide environment reference. Clear this field when using OAuth.

jira_service_management.cloudId.title: Cloud ID
jira_service_management.cloudId.description: Required for OAuth and scoped API-token modes: the site's canonical lowercase Cloud ID.

jira_service_management.accessToken.title: OAuth access token
jira_service_management.accessToken.description: For OAuth only: use a RocketRide environment reference for an externally managed access token. Clear this field when using API-token authentication.
